title: Rabbi Marion
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 19a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.19a.15): "Rabbi Marion said in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, and some say it: Rabbah bar Marion of the school of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai"; and in [Sukkah 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.32b.2): "Rabbi Marion said in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, and some say it: Rabbah bar Mari taught in the name of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai"; and Hyman reports a variant from Dikdukei Soferim: "And so it was taught in the school of Rabbi Marion in the name of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai." And we find in [Pesachim 103a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.103a.1): "Marta in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua"; and Hyman reports a variant from Dikdukei Soferim: "Maruna in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi." And it is possible that he is Rabbi Marion.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2545&lang=en) compares the alternative names in Eruvin and Sukkah. The two passages differ between Rabbah bar Marion and Rabbah bar Mari, and between Rabbi and Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. The consulted Pesachim says Marta gives a teaching in Rabbi Yehoshua’s name. Hyman’s possible identification relies on his report of the Maruna variant.
